input:
The co-ordinates of the point, where the line through A(3, 4, 1) and B(5, 1, 6) crosses the XZ-plane, are

Options:
A. (41/7, 0, 21/7)
B. (17/3, 0, 23/3)
C. (-11/3, 0, 21/7)
D. (17/7, 0, -23/3)

phase_1_understand_the_problem.problem_restatement: Find the point where the line through A(3,4,1) and B(5,1,6) intersects the XZ-plane (where y = 0).

given_information.to_find: Coordinates (x, 0, z) of the intersection point

phase_1_understand_the_problem.key_observation: Write the symmetric equation of the line through two points, set y = 0, and solve for the parameter to find x and z.

key_concepts: Equation of line through two points in 3D

phase_3_plan_the_approach.strategy: Write the line equation through A and B, set y = 0 to find the parameter value, substitute back to get x and z.
logical_steps: Step 1: Compute direction ratios of line AB
Step 2: Write symmetric form of the line
Step 3: Set y = 0 and solve for the parameter t
Step 4: Substitute t into x and z expressions
